title: Color Formats in Modern CSS
ques: Compare CSS color formats: **Hexadecimal (`#hex`)**, **`rgb()`/`rgba()`**, and modern **`hsl()`**. Write examples of each format representing an identical blue shade.
explanation: `hex` is compact, `rgb` describes light channels, and `hsl` (hue, saturation, lightness) is intuitive for generating tints, shades, and complementary color schemes.

title: Crafting Linear and Radial Gradients
ques: Demonstrate the use of **`linear-gradient()`** and **`radial-gradient()`** for creating smooth background color transitions.
explanation: Gradients are generated as CSS `<image>` data types. `linear-gradient` transitions colors along a directional vector, while `radial-gradient` radiates outwards from a focal point.

title: Configuring Background Images
ques: Demonstrate the essential properties for responsive background images: `background-image`, **`background-size: cover`**, `background-position: center`, and `background-repeat: no-repeat`.
explanation: `background-size: cover` ensures the background image fills the entire container without distorting aspect ratio, while pairing with an overlay gradient preserves text readability.
